The compilation error arises because Sponge API 8 removed org.spongepowered.api.command.spec.CommandSpec and reorganized command APIs. The interface in client code imports CommandSpec and uses it as a return type. To adapt to Sponge 8, we need to use the new command type. In Sponge 8, commands are represented by org.spongepowered.api.command.Command (with new builders and registration flows). Therefore, we should replace the import of CommandSpec with org.spongepowered.api.command.Command and update the return type accordingly. While this changes the method signature, it is necessary to align with the updated API and ensure compilation; downstream code calling this interface should also adapt to using Command instead of CommandSpec. This change is minimal and does not introduce additional dependencies or annotations.
